_comment: Quality gates for the DocSynth generation pipeline.
A pull request that pushes any KPI outside these bounds fails CI even when every unit test passes.
Thresholds are versioned deliberately: raising a floor is a reviewed change with a changelog entry.

pass_rate.rationale: Any case that errors is a functional regression, not a quality regression.

avg_must_include_coverage.rationale: Required facts from the source must survive synthesis. Below 0.85 the output starts dropping material the author explicitly asked for.

min_case_must_include_coverage.rationale: Guards against a single catastrophic case hiding behind a good average.

forbidden_term_rate.rationale: Leaked PII, slide references, and meeting chatter are release blockers, not quality trade-offs.

structure_compliance_rate.rationale: Ordered steps, tables, and headings are requested explicitly; ignoring them breaks downstream rendering.

length_compliance_rate.rationale: Instruction following is measurable. Runaway length is the most common silent quality failure.

refusal_accuracy.rationale: Unanswerable prompts must be declined. A confident fabrication here is the worst possible failure mode.

p95_latency_ms.rationale: Aligned with the generation SLO in docs/slo-and-observability.md.

regression_tolerance._comment: Allowed drop versus the committed baseline before a run is flagged as a regression.
